method: Headless Chromium (software WebGL via SwiftShader, no GPU), 1440x900, first viewport captured 6 s after DOMContentLoaded, with a 60-90 s retry for failures. Judged by eye from contact sheets on 1 Nov 2026. Software rendering is slower than a real GPU, so 'loader' verdicts overstate wait times; 'gpu-error' and 'dead' verdicts do not depend on that.

verdicts.strong: A complete, legible composition is on screen without needing heavy GPU work.
verdicts.loader: A percentage, progress bar or 'loading' state is the first impression.
verdicts.blank: Nothing meaningful is on screen (solid colour, single mark, or cookie bar only).
verdicts.gpu-error: The site requires WebGPU/WebGL and shows an error or incompatibility notice.
verdicts.graceful-fallback: No GPU, but the site explains and still delivers its content.
verdicts.gate: An intentional gate (enter / enable sound / choose device tier) before content.
verdicts.dead: The domain no longer serves the awarded site.
verdicts.not-captured: Could not render within 90 s in software GL.

audit.note: Dark field only after 90 s in software GL; the drivable world needs a real GPU.
